Classic 5-day bro split (Chest / Back / Legs / Shoulders / Arms) for hypertrophy. ~70 minutes per session. Designed for a well-equipped home gym with cable machine, leg press, leg curl/extension, abductor/adductor machine, barbell, dumbbells, and bench. Weekly volume per muscle (10-20 sets) follows Schoenfeld's hypertrophy guidelines: Chest 18, Back 18, Quads 11, Hamstrings 11, Shoulders (lateral) 8, Biceps 13, Triceps 14. Add your own warm-up and cooldown cardio (treadmill walking or spinning) before/after each session. Progress by adding 1 rep or 1.25-2.5 kg per week.
